notes.title: If you love Indecent Wife Hana, read this
notes.content:
Hey, you found my page!

Hi and welcome! My name is Fallen Eros and I'm an NTR game developer.

I've been an artist for 20 years and I'm finally releasing my first official project called "Indecent Wife Hana".

Indecent Wife Hana - Synopsis

A Visual Novel about Netorase (Wife Sharing). Tatsuki, the protagonist, discovers the pleasure of sharing his beloved wife, Hana, with another guy.

Indecent Wife Hana: Gravure

Sequel to "Indecent Wife Hana". After Tatsuki learns that Hana was a swimsuit model when she was young, she does a photo shoot with the same photographer as a gift for him. How far will Hana go to satisfy her husband's fetish? Find out in this cute but thrilling saga!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43323919/7f5c820ba34599ef99710dfe8252736a9b42ecad.png

Will you enjoy the game?

I've been working on "Indecent Wife Hana" for 2 years and the game has very positive reviews. I’m confident that I can deliver a unique and interesting take on the NTR genre and get you fully immersed in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43323919/1db1bf015ffe980c42e86d44344a87d683f8406b.png

If you value stories, meaningful choices, comedy and drama, then this game is for you. There is quite a lot of sexual content in the game, but the story can stand on its own. The general tone will be happy, but things might get a bit dark.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43323919/318cb98aa0f91285d3eab8ea0345f128bd4640c9.png

How often do you plan to release episodes?

I'm creating the art, writing the dialogue, programming the game, managing the Steam page and trying to build a team. I love to do this, but please understand that it's a huge amount of work for a single person.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43323919/d882970c92314b3f9700af64df78dc56b3a60ae9.png

Why should I become a supporter?

You’re helping the game become a reality and keeping me from going back to doing this as a hobby.

So, no matter the sum you pledge, you are supporting me and a team of creators and, moreover, you’re motivating us to complete the projects we start.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43323919/75066d63ed83826f0af4a2cc9f2c0498731beb7a.png

Your support will, of course, be rewarded!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43323919/06eef160af23a0a631cf9d0a44f0db8b4b84e3ca.png

If you happen to like what I'm creating and want to show your appreciation through a donation, please consider being my supporter. No donation is too small, and every donation is appreciated.

My heartfelt thanks to you for reading my page and for playing my game!



Cheers,

Fallen Eros

Disclaimer: The games produced by Fallen Eros don't include any illegal or forbidden content according to the Steam TOS.
